criteria.no: At least one decisive term is a subjective quality, private shorthand or code, or an approval with no named record.
criteria.unclear: A term may be undefined, but whether it is decisive is unclear.
criteria.yes: All decisive terms are defined by the statement or common technical usage.

self_contained.instructions: Is every decisive term in `anchor.statement` defined by the statement itself or by common technical usage? Undefined terms include subjective qualities (robust, clean, reliable), private shorthand or requirement codes (R7, the usual way), and approvals by a person with no named record. Concrete prohibitions, lists, paths, flags, commands, formats, and input-action-outcome conditions are defined.

anchor.statement: When TYPESAFE_API_KEY is set to canary-123 and transport fails, stdout, stderr, and saved run artifacts must omit canary-123 and Authorization: Bearer canary-123.
anchor.quote: test a transport failure with a canary TypeSafe key and make sure console output and saved run files contain neither the key nor its bearer header
anchor.scope: transport-error output and persisted run artifacts
